name: Womb of Worms
source:
Your goal is to find the host of Mulgrok's seed in your hometown before time runs out and he is born anew, sowing chaos all around the world.

Will you be able to identify the host and kill them in time? Who is human and who isn't? 

[From [url=https://horse-hoof-games.itch.io/womb-of-worms]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的目标是在时间耗尽之前在你的家乡找到莫尔格罗克种子的宿主，他会重生，在世界各地播下混乱的种子。

你能及时识别宿主并杀死他们吗？谁是人类，谁不是？

[来自[url=https://horse-hoof-games.itch.io/womb-of-worms]Itch.io[/url]]
